brief.text: Create an asymmetric mechanical Earth–Moon instrument with a tilted globe, lunar mechanism, visible gears and index markers on a machined brass and dark enamel base. Include a moving mechanical assembly and refine the design from whole-asset and detail views.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained globe instrument with its base, orbit mechanism and gear train.

revisions.title: Feet and globe relief
revisions.description: Raised the feet and flattened the stylized continent patches.

revisions.title: Gear placement revision
revisions.description: Raised and enlarged the gears and moved their adjoining crank parts.

revisions.title: Current gallery revision
revisions.description: Shortened gear hubs, added caps, adjusted the land color, moved the phase rod and seated the plaque.
